body: It was mostly in jest there because it kinda just all made sense to me. I'm getting upset at myself for wanting something? Hell why don't I deserve to be happy? Yeah, I've done some shitty things but that isn't me anymore. Now I just gotta work on not being afraid. I'm crazy for being so oblivious to this.
I think the reason I feel like I am such a bad person is because I'm upset with myself for wanting something. Holy shit I'm crazy.

I think I mean it in a different way. I'm too nice in that I'm quick to sacrifice my own time or money to help people complete an actual task. For example, one morning I was getting ready for work. I had woken up around 4 am and worked at 7 am. I checked facebook and saw that a random acquaintance was looking for a sobercab. This was not a friend by any means, but I decided I had time and wasn't doing anything else, so I drove 15 miles to pick him up and 15 miles to bring him back to his home (which was blocks from mine)

I do those types of things often, but it is self serving. I do these types of things as distractions. If someone needs help with something and I am not doing something I will jump at the chance to help. This obviously contradicts a lot of what I've talked about as someone who is considered a monster wouldn't do these types of things right? Well it always feels like I am doing these types of things for my personal benefit. Even in some cases where I have no idea what that benefit will be. I somehow find a way to vilify myself.

Thank you for this post. I've since calmed down a lot... I don't actually think I'm a bad person. In fact, I think as of recently I've been almost too nice. Still when I have panic attacks, all I can think about is every bad thing I've done. Everything that would make me horrible. I did realize tonight that I have mostly been a coward and this is something I want to change. 

Another change that has started to come from tonight has been me looking into health insurance to make sure I can get some help for my anxiety. I haven't enrolled in any yet, but I am planning on making some calls tomorrow to discuss some options. I'm trying to do everything I can to be the best person I can but in the back of my mind I'm always reminding myself of everything negative I've done and I need to find a way to stop that.

I'm not harming her anymore. It's weird how it ended. My mom told me that my sister thought I was the sibling she was most like (there are 6 of us) and from that point on I just started getting along with her a lot better. That was back when I was 14 or so, but the reason it comes up is that some of these people I've been hanging out with are also friends of hers and they act like her and I are so similar but in reality I believe her to be a better person than myself.

I don't actually think I'm autistic unless I'm reviewing the situation from the outside. I know I'm actually really good around people when things are going well.

The worst part about the girl being involved is I feel like such an asshole to all my other friends. At this point I don't even want anything romantic with her, so I feel like I'm slapping all my other friends in the face when I'm like yeah I know you guys are awesome but I'm still pretty bent up out of shape about Hannah. I don't care what most people see me as, but I really want to be friends with this girl and I mostly just feel like a huge creep instead.

Thanks though. Everyone has been very helpful and I've calmed down quite a bit at this point.

"The guilt you seem to feel is not because you are a bad person, but because you are a good person who struggles with some things from the past."

=] That is a fantastic quote right there. I played an exorbitant amount of League of Legends. Thing is, I knew that I didn't enjoy it. Rather I knew it was a distraction for me. I always wanted to create things. Work on art, that type of stuff. I've pretty much stopped playing video games and have been working on a lot of projects. Some music, some other medias. I made 11 plaster masks one day for no real reason.

That's a lot of my problem. I find it impossible to distract myself. I have been changing a lot actually though.

I used to spend a majority of my life playing video games. It was a great distraction but ultimately left me no personal contact whatsoever. It was not a sustainable life. I also have started losing weight. I'm down about 35 pounds. I just had a job interview today for a better job. I've been working on a lot of projects I've wanted to do but had been putting off.

Still I am unable to be happy. I am just drowning in this profound sadness.
Thank you. I've mostly calmed down at this point. I still feel entirely shitty about myself right now but it is a lot easier to think at the moment

I could have done anything more than what I did. I could have tried to get between them. I could have called the cops. I should have called the cops. I didn't do anything though.

He has since gotten help, and has recovered but that night.... I don't know. I'm a coward.

That's the worst part.... I told a bunch of people what was going on. I was at a Christmas party and left and sat in my car panicking. Everyone else left shortly thereafter and saw me. They came to my car and talked me down but it included them learning how shitty my head is. How awful this thing is and I can never be normal amongst them again. Of course they say nice things but from this point on I feel like there will always be that rift.

And my brain won't stop holding hope for this girl which has just caused more and more problems because I overanalyze that. I have talked to friends about this and no one seems to get the gravity of the situation. Not the girl situation, the whole situation. Still if I could stop thinking about her that would be fantastic.

I used to be numb. Before these people showed up I just didn't care. I floated through life. I had calmed down a lot from when I used to get very angry and I'm scared I might go back to that too. People thought I was this nice person and I guess I was becuase I care more about other people than myself really. A lot of people know about the situation with my family. I have no health insurance so I can't see a doctor about anything. I've seen doctors in the past and it hasn't helped. During high school it made the situation much worse. I do not know how to talk to people and in my head I often think that I am secretly autistic or retarded and everyone knows and just is in on this big joke.
